## 1. Summary

Thiago Macedo Mendes is a Computer Science undergraduate at UNIR ('29) and Informatics graduate from IFRO ('25) living in Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil. He works with systems programming in C and Rust, declarative Linux setups with NixOS, and web development using TypeScript, Next.js, React, and Laravel. He has experience in academic research labs (GPMecatrônica, GoTec) and IT infrastructure support at Censipam (Ministry of Defense).

## 4. Featured Projects

### toof-os
- **URL:** https://github.com/o-thiago/ToofOS
- **Stack:** Nix Flakes, NixOS, Raspberry Pi 4, DACC Station (UNIR), nix-ld, SDL2, Wayland
- **Summary:** Declarative NixOS configuration built for the DACC Station (a gaming arcade console project at UNIR) on Raspberry Pi 4. Features a universal `nix-ld` game runtime for student games, low-latency audio via PipeWire/rtkit, ananicy-cpp process scheduling, SD card wear optimizations, and gamepad support (Xbox and DualShock 4).

### GPMecatrônica Cards Platform
- **URL:** https://github.com/o-thiago/gpm-cards
- **Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Nix / process-compose, Docker
- **Summary:** Web application built with Next.js and PostgreSQL for member profiles and digital card generation, featuring automated local database setup via Nix process-compose.

### sqlx-conditional-queries-layering
- **URL:** https://github.com/o-thiago/sqlx-conditional-queries-layering
- **Author:** Thiago Macedo Mendes (@o-thiago)
- **Stack:** Rust, SQLx, Declarative Macros, paste, macro_metavar_expr
- **Summary:** Rust declarative macro library for defining, extending, and merging conditional SQL query templates on top of sqlx_conditional_queries at compile time.

### Innovation Radar
- **Stack:** TypeScript, React, Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Docker, Storybook
- **Summary:** Web platform built at GoTec (IFRO) to catalog and track innovation initiatives and intellectual property.
